title: Big: Tom Hanks' Magical Coming-of-Age Classic
imageHint: Large piano keyboard on the floor of a toy store with someone dancing on the keys
description: When 12-year-old Josh Baskin makes a wish to be 'big' at a carnival machine, he gets more than he bargained for in this heartwarming tale of childhood wonder.

questions.question: Who plays the adult Josh Baskin after he makes his wish?
questions.explanation: Tom Hanks delivers an Oscar-nominated performance as the adult Josh, perfectly capturing the innocence and wonder of a child in a man's body.

questions.question: What is the name of the carnival fortune-telling machine that grants Josh's wish?
questions.explanation: The Zoltar fortune-telling machine is the mystical device that transforms young Josh into an adult after he wishes to be 'big.'

questions.question: What song do Josh and his boss play together on the giant piano at FAO Schwarz?
questions.explanation: Josh and Mr. MacMillan play 'Heart and Soul' on the famous floor piano at FAO Schwarz in one of cinema's most memorable scenes.

questions.question: What toy company does Josh work for as an adult?
questions.explanation: Josh lands a job at MacMillan Toy Company, where his childlike perspective on toys makes him incredibly valuable to the business.

questions.question: What is the name of Josh's love interest at the toy company?
questions.explanation: Susan Lawrence, played by Elizabeth Perkins, is the marketing executive who falls for Josh's unique charm and childlike wonder.
